C0243.title: FTC Sues Experian for CAN-SPAM Act Violations
C0243.summary: In August 2023, the FTC sued Experian Consumer Services, alleging that it sent marketing emails to account holders without an effective unsubscribe mechanism, violating CAN-SPAM requirements on opt-out handling, commercial email identification, and processing of unsubscribe requests. The Department of Justice later announced a permanent injunction and a USD 650,000 civil penalty, requiring Experian to stop sending commercial marketing emails that consumers could not effectively unsubscribe from and to improve future compliance for account marketing emails.
